```{r load data}
biom2025 <- read_csv(here("raw data", "algae", "biomass_density_COMPLETE_2025.csv"))
coords2025 <- read_csv(here("raw data", "algae", "logbooks2025.csv"), locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"))
sample_sites <- read_csv(here("raw data", "algae", "sample_site_summary.csv"))
head(biom2025)
head(coords2025)
head(sample_sites)
```
```{r trim coords}
coords_small <- coords2025 |> 
  mutate(
    Site = trimws(Site),
    Latitude = parse_number(as.character(Latitude)),
    Longitude = parse_number(as.character(Longitude))
  )  |> 
  select(Site, Latitude, Longitude)  |> 
  distinct(Site, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r modify data frame and merge coords}
quadrat_biom2025 <- biom2025 |> 
  rename(
    Bag.sample_weight = 'Bag+sample_weight',
    Site = site)|> 
  mutate(
    Site    = trimws(Site),
    biomass = pmax(Bag.sample_weight - bag_weight_g, 0)) |> 
  left_join(coords_small, by = "Site") |> 
  select(
    Site, 
    quadrat, 
    sample_type, 
    biomass, 
    Latitude, 
    Longitude) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_type,
    values_from = biomass) |> 
  mutate(
    eel_alg_ratio = case_when(
      algae > 0                    ~ eelgrass / algae,
      algae == 0 & eelgrass > 0    ~ Inf,
      TRUE                         ~ NA_real_
    ),
    alg_eel_ratio = case_when(
      eelgrass > 0                 ~ algae / eelgrass,
      eelgrass == 0 & algae > 0    ~ Inf,
      TRUE                         ~ NA_real_
    ),
    site          = reorder(Site, Latitude, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    site_position = as.numeric(site)
  )
```
```{r Chisasibi fig}
ratio_chis <- ggplot(
  quadrat_biom2025 |> 
    filter(is.finite(alg_eel_ratio),
           alg_eel_ratio > 0,
           site %in% c(
      "CH38-00",
      "CH38-06",
      "CH34-00",
      "CH33-00",
      "CH03-00")), 
  aes(x = site, y = alg_eel_ratio)) +
  scale_y_log10()+
  geom_boxplot(
      fill = "green4",
      alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(
    y = "Algae / Eelgrass",
    x = "Site")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                               hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", 
           x = 3, 
           y = 10, 
           label = "More algae", 
           color = "black", 
           fontface = "bold", 
           size = 4,
           alpha = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", 
           x = 3, 
           y = 0.1, 
           label = "More eelgrass", 
           color = "black", 
           fontface = "bold", 
           size = 4,
           alpha = 0.8) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 3,
    xend = 3,
    y = 12,
    yend = 30,
    arrow = arrow(
      length = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    ),
    color = "slategray",
    linewidth = 1) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 3,
    xend = 3,
    y = 0.07,
    yend = 0.02,
    arrow = arrow(
      length = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    ),
    color = "slategray",
    linewidth = 1)
ratio_chis
```

```{r alg/eel all}
ratio_all <- ggplot(
  quadrat_biom2025 |> 
    filter(is.finite(alg_eel_ratio),
           alg_eel_ratio > 0), 
  aes(x = site, y = alg_eel_ratio)) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_number(accuracy = 1))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, size = 2, alpha = 0.7)+
  labs(
    y = "Algae / Eelgrass (Log g dry biomass / 0.0625 m²)") +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  geom_hline(
  yintercept = 1,
  color = "red",
  linetype = "dashed",
  linewidth = 0.8,
  alpha = 0.5
)
ratio_all
```

```{r eel trend}
eelgrass_trend <-
  ggplot(
    quadrat_biom2025,
    aes(x = site_position,
        y = eelgrass))+
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(group = site_position),
    color = "gray80",
    outlier.shape = NA)+
  scale_y_log10()+
  geom_smooth(
    aes(group = 1),
    method = "loess",
    span = 0.9,
    color = "green4",
    fill = "green4",
    alpha = 0.15,
    linewidth = 1.2,
    formula = y ~ x)+
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = sort(unique(quadrat_biom2025$site_position)),
    labels = levels(quadrat_biom2025$site)) +
  theme_classic()+
  labs(
    x = "Site (South → North)",
    y = "Eelgrass (g/0.0625 m²)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.x = element_blank())
eelgrass_trend
```

```{r}
long_quadrat_biom <- quadrat_biom2025 |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(algae, ruppia, eelgrass, fucus), 
               names_to = "Sample_type", 
               values_to = "Biomass")

eel_alg_biom <-
  long_quadrat_biom |> 
  filter(Sample_type %in% c("eelgrass", "algae")) |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(x = site, y = Biomass, fill = Sample_type)) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_number(accuracy = 1))+
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge2(width = 0.75, padding = 0.2))+
   scale_fill_manual(
      name = NULL,              
      values = c("eelgrass" = "green4",          
                 "algae"    = "wheat3")) +
  labs(y = "Biomass (Log g / 0.0625 m²)") +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.05, 0.95),    
        legend.justification = c(0, 1),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA)
    )
eel_alg_biom
```

```{r Site Map}
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "sf", "rnaturalearth", "rnaturalearthdata", "ggspatial", "rnaturalearthhires", repos = "https://ropensci.r-universe.dev"))
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(ggspatial)
library(patchwork)

land <- ne_download(scale = 10, type = "land", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf")
sites <- st_as_sf(sample_sites, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)

bb <- st_bbox(c(xmin = -82, xmax = -78, ymin = 50.5, ymax = 55), crs = st_crs(4326))
land_crop <- st_crop(st_make_valid(land), bb)

study_box <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(
  c(xmin = -82, xmax = -78, ymin = 51.5, ymax = 55),
  crs = st_crs(4326)
))

land_overview <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", continent = "North America",
                              returnclass = "sf")

site_key <- sites |>
  mutate(Lat = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2],
         Lon = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1]) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  distinct(Site, Lat, Lon) |>
  arrange(desc(Lat)) |>
  mutate(num = row_number())
sites_num <- sites |> left_join(select(site_key, Site, num), by = "Site")
```

```{r}
inset_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = land_overview, fill = "white", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = study_box, fill = NA, color = "red", linewidth = 0.4) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-95, -60), ylim = c(42, 65), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8))


site_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = land_crop, fill = "white", color = NA, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = sites, aes(color = `Survey data`, shape = `Survey data`), size = 3)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 15, 17)) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-82, -78), ylim =c(51.5, 55), expand = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 4) +
  annotation_scale(
    location = "bl",              # bottom left
    width_hint = 0.18,
    text_cex = 0.6,
    bar_cols = c("black", "white"),
    line_width = 0.5
  ) +
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "bl",              # bottom right
    which_north = "true",
    style = north_arrow_minimal(text_size = 12),
    height = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    width = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    pad_x = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    pad_y = unit(0.6, "cm")
  )+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue"))
site_map

final_map <- site_map +
  inset_element(inset_map, left = 0.02, bottom = 0.7, right = 0.32, top = 1)
final_map
```
